summary: Implementation (commit 0daed1e7c) fully realizes the saved plan for issue #461. New common/git_auth.py provides is_bitbucket_repo, host-scoped credential-helper config entries that reference only $BITBUCKET_EMAIL/$BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN env-var names (no literal token), apply_bitbucket_git_auth (in-place GIT_CONFIG_* accumulator + GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0), verify_bitbucket_git_auth, and the new reason code BITBUCKET_GIT_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED. service/worker._service_git_environment adds a host-scoped BitBucket block after the unchanged GitHub block and shares add_git_config_entries (local dup removed), covering clone (GitManager env) and push (inherited os.environ). node/git_manager.ensure_mirror preflights bitbucket creds and fails fast with a reason-coded GitOperationError before any git runs; GitHub repos are a no-op. node/secret_mounts.py adds a bitbucket provider injecting BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN/BITBUCKET_EMAIL ${VAR} placeholders, reusing existing reason-coded mismatch/missing paths. token_patterns.py adds the Atlassian ATATT shape to both known-token patterns. doctor/reasons.py + REASON_CATALOG.md register/document the reason code. docker/compose/local-service.yml + .env.example pass the BitBucket env through. Tests cover all areas (test_git_auth, test_token_patterns, test_git_manager, test_secret_lease_mounts, test_worker, test_doctor_reasons, integration compose). Security: token lives only in an env var, never in URL/config/args/logs. GitHub path byte-for-byte unchanged. Focused validation results (all green; mypy success; 100% coverage of new modules) are recorded in plan section 9 and the commit message.
